defaultValue.html:
Knowing where to seek care ensures you get the right treatment without unnecessary hospital wait times or costs.

Choose Urgent Care at [[geomodifier]] for:

  • Sprains, strains, and suspected simple fractures
  • Cuts, lacerations, and minor bleeding requiring stitches
  • Mild to moderate asthma or breathing difficulty
  • Sore throat, ear pain, fever, or flu symptoms
  • Minor burns, rashes, and insect/animal bites
  • Urinary tract infections and abdominal discomfort

Call 911 or Go Immediately to the ER for:

  • Chest pain, pressure, or symptoms of stroke (facial drooping, numbness)
  • Severe shortness of breath or sudden severe headache
  • Uncontrolled bleeding or major severe trauma
  • Loss of consciousness or sudden confusion/seizures
  • Compound fractures (bone protruding through skin)
